_comment: Seed dataset modelling Факултет "Полиция" at Академия на МВР (Sofia), all four years. Researched fact: the faculty's five катедри, the two cadet specialties it teaches (ППООР and Гранична полиция), and the academic ranks. Modelled, not cited: group sizes (standard Bulgarian учебна група of ~25 -- the Academy does not publish enrolment), the distribution of subjects across the four years, and the instructor names, which are generic Bulgarian surnames rather than real staff. Lectures are delivered to the whole поток (a multi-group subject needing a large аудитория); семинарни занятия run per group.
